statement: Independent post-merge evidence on one host and one revision with emulated failures. Not production qualification; production stays on its last qualified configuration.

bicdb_verifier.revision: d2a7fe1cab42bd5dd0838b74df9af36bc7148c09 (local merge of 64251c3e and unmerged PR #85 head 2a64e329fd203ca7bfbb46585f6e4475c3d49b37, not pushed)

durability_child.use: built as requested; not used by the independent harness

environment.host: s3ny (warm standby host; shared with other jobs; production service untouched)
environment.isolation: systemd transient units Nice=19 CPUWeight=10 IOWeight=10 MemoryMax=16G MemorySwapMax=0 LimitCORE=0

harness.ledger: per-client JSON lines, fsync per line, outside the database directory
checks: a acked present with exact row set
c 08007 identity matches txid_current and resolves via bicdb_commit_outcome to committed/not_committed matching presence, stable across recoveries
d no unwritten rows, no partial transactions, no resurrected deletes
e secondary/unique/primary index results equal full scan; duplicate key refused
f verify-store --read-only before recovery 1, before recovery 2 and after clean shutdown; files unchanged by verifier
no ack after a client's first 08007/58030 within one incarnation

emulated_vs_real.process_crash: real SIGKILL or abort() at BICDB_TEST_CRASH_AT points
emulated_vs_real.power_loss: EMULATED: page-log unsynced tail truncated at the crash point (BICDB_TEST_WAL_VOLATILE_TAIL=1); no real power cut; other files keep page-cache state
emulated_vs_real.io_failure: EMULATED: BICDB_TEST_FAIL_IO returns EIO instead of doing the I/O; no real device error; no kernel post-fsync-failure page-cache behaviour
emulated_vs_real.torn_tail_and_damage: EMULATED by editing frame logs of a SIGKILLed server

cross_cutting_findings: docs/evidence/storage-durability-harness-2026-11-08/README.md section 5: 12 failures in 1,422 plain-SIGKILL recoveries of server_paged stores (11 stress, 1 smallwal; 0 in default and smallpool; 0 in 570 embedded recoveries); classes: F1 silent loss after successful open (1), F2 secondary index silently missing committed rows (6), F3 open refused page beyond end (3), F4 open refused wrong page type (1) or panic btree.rs:430 (1); all deterministic on replay; none at the recovery of a fired injected boundary.
